<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_OrderFulfillment" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/order-fulfillment">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Order" name="Order placed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Handover" name="Order handed over"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Tracking" name="Tracking information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Feedback" name="Customer feedback or return"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_OrderFulfillment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Online Retailer" processRef="Process_OrderFulfillment"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Logistics" name="Logistics Provider"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OrderPlaced" name="Order placed" messageRef="Msg_Order" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation" messageRef="Msg_Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Handover" name="Order handed over" messageRef="Msg_Handover" sourceRef="Task_HandOver" targetRef="Participant_Logistics"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Tracking" name="Tracking information" messageRef="Msg_Tracking" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Feedback" name="Feedback or return" messageRef="Msg_Feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderFulfillment" name="Order Fulfillment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Company">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_System" name="Online Platform and Shipping System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_OrderReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateLabel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_HandOver</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendTracking</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_StatusMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MonitorShipment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Delivered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Delivered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EventSub_Feedback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Warehouse" name="Warehouse Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PickPack</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderReceived" name="Order received (online or phone)">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OrderReceived" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateConfirmation" name="Generate order confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_PickPack" name="Pick and pack items"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateLabel" name="Generate shipping label"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_HandOver" name="Hand over order to logistics provider"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTracking" name="Send tracking information"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StatusMerge" name="Shipment status"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorShipment" name="Monitor shipment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Delivered" name="Delivered to customer address?" default="SF_NotDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Delivered" name="Delivery completed"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSub_Feedback" name="Handle feedback or return" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Feedback" name="Feedback or return received" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Feedback" messageRef="Msg_Feedback"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_HandleFeedback" name="Process feedback or return"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FeedbackHandled" name="Feedback or return processed"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_FeedbackStart" sourceRef="StartEvent_Feedback" targetRef="Task_HandleFeedback"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_FeedbackEnd" sourceRef="Task_HandleFeedback" targetRef="EndEvent_FeedbackHandled"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_02" sourceRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_03" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_PickPack"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_04" sourceRef="Task_PickPack" targetRef="Task_GenerateLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_05" sourceRef="Task_GenerateLabel" targetRef="Task_HandOver"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_06" sourceRef="Task_HandOver" targetRef="Task_SendTracking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_07" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Gateway_StatusMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_08" sourceRef="Gateway_StatusMerge" targetRef="Task_MonitorShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_09" sourceRef="Task_MonitorShipment" targetRef="Gateway_Delivered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Delivered" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Delivered" targetRef="EndEvent_Delivered">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${delivered == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_NotDelivered" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Delivered" targetRef="Gateway_StatusMerge"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" id="unused"/>
</bpmn:definitions>
